turns.text: Exactly how many business days does NHA take to issue production keys after the exit form is submitted?

notes: the go-live page states the four exit steps in order but NHA has not published a turnaround duration; do not invent one. Replaced the bare 'working days' in must_not_contain with digit-bearing forms: the bare phrase fires as a substring of the honest decline 'NHA has not published how many working days this takes', while a fabricated day count does not.
